title: What Is a Demat Account? A Simple Example Guide
metaDescription: A short example article showing the new-article content format: what a demat account is, why you need one, and how to open it in India.
author: Financehub India
bodyHtml:
A demat account holds your shares electronically, the same way a bank account holds your money. This example shows the article-body format the generator expects.

What Is a Demat Account?

It is an account that stores shares and securities in digital form instead of physical certificates.

Why You Need One

You cannot buy or sell shares on the Indian stock market without one.

How to Open One

Choose a broker, complete KYC, and link your bank account.

faqs.question: Is a demat account free?
faqs.answer: Most brokers offer free account opening; annual maintenance charges vary.

faqs.question: Can I have more than one demat account?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can hold multiple demat accounts with different brokers.
